description: Use this when the signed-in owner wants an approved post to go out at a different time, or to book an approved post that isn't booked yet. Give the time in the business's own timezone. First call it without confirm: it says exactly what would change and changes nothing. Show that to the owner, and call again with confirm true only after they say yes. Only posts the owner already approved; a post that's already posted can't be moved. Each post publishes once per platform.

confirm.description: True only after the owner saw what will change and said yes

when.description: The new time in the business's own timezone as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM (e.g. 2026-11-07T19:00), or now

name: reschedule_post
title: Change when a post goes out
